sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
sources.snippet: Kimi K2 is our latest Mixture-of-Experts model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in frontier knowledge, math, and coding among non-thinking models.

sources.title: Kimi AI with K3 | Built for Agentic Coding & Knowledge Work
sources.snippet: Try Kimi K3 to build playable multiplayer and 3D games, create consulting grade slides, and run parallel tasks with Swarm and Goal to get more work done.
